purpose: Each criterion of US-20501 driven through the real npm pack in packages/rcf-lite and, for the journey, the tarball it writes installed into a fresh directory and run through the installed package's own bin with a read-logging preload (test/fixtures/read-log/hook.mjs).
title: rcf/ out of the npm tarball: the real npm pack and the packed-tarball journey (through npm and the installed bin)

testCases.description: AC-20501-3: no file in the tarball npm pack produces carries development-chain material: no named reviewer, stage-keeper or operator; no relay, work-item, dispatch or lane job id; no verdict record; no quoted or cited development ruling
testCases.testPointer: test/pkg/pack-privacy-0-41-0.test.js::AC-20501-3: no file in the tarball npm pack produces carries development-chain material: no named reviewer, stage-keeper or operator; no relay, work-item, dispatch or lane job id; no verdict record; no quoted or cited development ruling

testCases.description: AC-20501-4: no file in the tarball npm pack produces carries a developer home directory, an internal specification or estate path, or a consumer project, team or developer handle; the consumer names come from RCF_PRIVACY_FORBIDDEN_TERMS (the repository secret in CI), and a run without it prints one line naming the skipped class and still checks the generic shapes
